items.title: Loading screen text contrast is insufficient
items.what: The text 'SM KARATE KIDS', 'ASMONGOLD VS HASANABI', 'Downloading the game', and 'A SHOEMONEY AI LABS GAME' on the loading screen is hard to read against the dark background.
items.why: Low contrast text is difficult to read, especially on mobile devices where screen visibility can vary.
items.how: Increase the contrast of the text by either darkening the background or brightening the text color.

items.title: Countdown timer text is unclear
items.what: The countdown timer text ('FIGHT IN 2', 'FIGHT IN 3', etc.) is not prominently displayed and blends into the background.
items.why: Players need clear visual cues for timing, especially in a fast-paced game like this.
items.how: Make the countdown timer text more prominent by increasing its size, using a higher contrast color, or adding a border around it.

items.title: Move indicators are not distinct enough
items.what: The indicators for moves like 'Lunge Punch', 'Front Kick', etc., are not clearly visible and can be missed during gameplay.
items.why: Clear indication of moves is crucial for players to understand and execute techniques correctly.
items.how: Enhance the visibility of move indicators by using more contrasting colors and larger, bolder fonts.

items.title: Control sticks lack visual feedback
items.what: The control sticks for stance and technique do not provide clear visual feedback when pressed or moved.
items.why: Visual feedback is essential for touch controls to ensure players know their inputs are registered.
items.how: Add visual feedback such as color changes or animations when the control sticks are interacted with.

items.title: Score display is hard to read
items.what: The score display (e.g., 'ASMONGOLD 0', 'HASANABI 0') at the top of the screen is not easily legible, especially during fast-paced actions.
items.why: Players need to quickly and easily see their score to make strategic decisions.
items.how: Increase the size and contrast of the score display text to make it more readable.
